title: fpvsim-scenario v1
description: An fpv-sim scenario: map, drone, conditions, firmware, start, task, episode limits, observations and domain randomization. Units: metres, seconds, degrees. Frame: ENU (x east, y north, z up). See docs/SCENARIO_FORMAT.md. Component ids, preset names and map ids are checked by the simulator (src/scenario/scenario.ts), not by this schema.

spawn.description: a named spawn of the map (its spawns)

oneOf.description: release the payload (ops.payload) so it lands within radiusM of target (horizontal miss)

nav.description: navigation sensors in the observations: magnetometer, rangefinder, optical flow

actors.description: add Observation.actors and its numbers at the end of the vector

ops.description: the operational environment (docs/OPERATIONS.md): radio or fibre-optic link, jammers and GNSS spoofers, scheduled faults, a payload

pos.description: east, north, height above the ground (m)
